At FlowSpace I built and operate production AI agents: support agents that answer customer queries from live platform data and escalate to a person when confidence is low, and an AI listing bot that turns a brochure in any format into a drafted listing with a human in the loop. At UltraStrategy I built a CV-parsing pipeline (n8n, Eden AI, the Claude API, Affinda) that extracts data, scores relevance for a role type and generates a standardised CV. My daily tools are TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Laravel, n8n and Claude Code. My Python is currently at a learning level, not yet a production strength, so I would contribute on the TypeScript and workflow side first while I close that gap. I would engage from Italy under Partita IVA and can cover the required time overlap.
